text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Dishes lavishly seasoned with spices and oils are fine indeed, but when one selects truly rare ingredients, bringing out their natural flavor is the highest form of true cuisine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
香辛料や調味油を不断に注いだ料理も
重畳なれど、
類稀なる素材を選りすぐったならば、
其の物の味を活かした調理こそ
真の美味と申すべき至上でありんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: With optimal heat, preserving the ingredient’s natural flavor—crisply seared on the outside while leaving a tender red center within. Seasoned simply with just the right amount of salt. There is hardly a greater luxury than this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最善の火加減にて、
素材の味のままに。
表面は香ばしく焼き上げ、
内は柔らかき赤身を残す。
味付けは程好く塩のみで。
此れに勝る贅沢は、
早々御座んせん。
